headers_row1.label: TRANSFORM LAYER  -  every cell is a formula.  Never type here.  Joins RAW_Bosta + RAW_Intake + RAW_Costs + RAW_SKU and applies Config.
PASTE ZONE  -  the Bosta order export, exactly as downloaded.  Select all in Bosta's file, copy, paste-special VALUES into A3.  Do not rename columns, do not sort, do not delete rows.
PASTE ZONE  -  the Bosta wallet / Cash Cycles export, exactly as downloaded.  Paste values only into A3.  Total Fees is the number this system charges against each shipment.
PASTE ZONE  -  Hadeer's Google Sheet, downloaded as .xlsx.  Paste values only into A3.  Columns match her sheet exactly, so there is no mapping step.

REFERENCE TABLE  -  one row per product variant exactly as Bosta writes it in the Description field.  Fill price_egp and cogs_egp.  Data_Quality flags any variant that appears in an order but is missing here.
